facts.fact: Orzo 查不出这栋房子归谁。
facts.anchor: I couldn’t find anything on whose house this is.

facts.fact: 屋里没有照片、私物和邮件。
facts.anchor: There are no pictures covering the walls, no personal belongings or mail.

facts.fact: 他的结论：住在这里的人是个幽灵。
facts.anchor: Whoever lives here is a ghost.

facts.fact: 他定位她的手机一路追到城外。
facts.anchor: I tracked Cinnamon’s phone across town

facts.fact: 他本可以打开她的电脑翻文件。
facts.anchor: I should open it, go through the files.
I’ll let her tell me instead.
I want her to trust me.

facts.fact: 他替她的手机插上充电。
他锁好所有门窗再把自己锁在门外。
facts.anchor: I secure all the windows and doors before letting myself out the front and locking it behind me.

facts.fact: 他还要去找名单上最后一个 Aldente。
facts.anchor: I still need to uncover the whereabouts of the last Aldente on the list
